All twenty-three baselines are from one real-device run on 2026-08-17, the run that recorded ticket 19's write-channel fix - superseding the previous file, whose non-archive-restore numbers predated a device OS update and whose archive-restore family was a median of three ticket-17 runs. One run rather than several: unlike ticket 17, nothing here is close enough to its target to need run-to-run spread to defend, and the write-path change moved its two headline numbers by more than an order of magnitude, which no plausible noise band would explain away. targetMs for photo-add, archive-restore and archive-restore-files carries extra headroom over this baseline precisely because it is one run instead of several; see ticket 19's verification note for the reasoning per number.
